# Migrate memory-core services to flatter SDK structure (M6 MC)

# Migrate memory-core services to flatter SDK structure (M6 MC)

## Context
Second Tier-1 sub-ticket of M6 epic #10982. Memory Core server: 417 LOC `Server.mjs`, ~14 services + `lifecycle/` subdirectories. This is the **largest substantive M6 lift**. It follows the pattern established in the M6 KB sub-ticket (#10983).

## The Problem
Memory Core services live under `ai/mcp/server/memory-core/services/` and are imported into `ai/services.mjs` via that path. Per M6 design (`v13-path.md` §4 + D4), services flatten into the SDK structure; `Server.mjs` shrinks from 417 LOC → <50 LOC thin endpoint wrapper consuming services via the SDK. 

## The Architectural Reality
MC service inventory (approximate):
```
ai/mcp/server/memory-core/services/
├── EdgeGraphService.mjs
├── GraphService.mjs
├── MemoryService.mjs
├── PermissionService.mjs
├── SessionService.mjs
├── SummarizationService.mjs
├── TaskService.mjs
├── ... (and lifecycle subdirs)
```
Current `ai/services.mjs` imports use `Memory_*` namespace prefixes. Preserving these post-migration is non-negotiable for SDK consumer compatibility.
`Server.mjs` (417 LOC) currently handles tool registration and service singleton wiring. Migration removes service singleton wiring (shifts to SDK) and leaves only tool registration + BaseServer extension boilerplate.

## The Fix
**Proposed SDK layout:**
```
ai/services/memory-core/
├── EdgeGraphService.mjs
├── GraphService.mjs
├── MemoryService.mjs
├── ... (other services + lifecycle subdirs)
```

Sequence:
1. **Move:** `git mv ai/mcp/server/memory-core/services/* ai/services/memory-core/`
2. **Update SDK imports:** Edit `ai/services.mjs` to point at new locations; preserve `Memory_*` prefixes verbatim.
3. **Update Server.mjs:** Edit `ai/mcp/server/memory-core/Server.mjs` to import services via `ai/services.mjs` rather than directly; remove local-services-singleton wiring.
4. **Shrink target:** `Server.mjs` <50 LOC. (Note: given the number of tools, it might be slightly larger, but the goal is to remove all service instantiations).
5. **Verify Factory pattern intact:** unit + integration suite passes; `RequestContextService.run` wraps dispatch unchanged.
6. **Capture LOC delta** in PR body per M6 epic AC7.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] **AC1:** All MC services + lifecycle subdirectories relocated from `ai/mcp/server/memory-core/services/` to `ai/services/memory-core/`
- [ ] **AC2:** `ai/services.mjs` imports updated; `Memory_*` namespace prefixes preserved verbatim (no consumer-facing API change)
- [ ] **AC3:** `ai/mcp/server/memory-core/Server.mjs` shrunk to <50 LOC (or as close to tool-registration-only as possible)
- [ ] **AC4:** Cross-family review approval per swarm PR review routing (one peer review minimum)
- [ ] **AC5:** Unit row + integration row green on PR
- [ ] **AC6:** LOC delta captured in PR body (target: >30% LOC moved from MCP server tree → SDK tree per M6 epic AC7)

## Out of Scope
- Service-internal refactors (separate tickets if needed)
- Adding new MC tools or service surfaces
- BaseServer-extension regressions (out of scope; M2 substrate is stable)
- Other server migrations (separate sub-tickets per M6 epic)

## Avoided Traps / Gold Standards Rejected
- **Rejected: rename `Memory_*` namespace prefixes during migration.** Cascading breaking change for SDK consumers.
- **Rejected: flatten ALL way to `ai/services/*.mjs` (no per-domain subdir).** Risks namespace collisions across servers. Per-domain subdir resolves this without re-renaming.
- **Rejected: Bundle with other servers.** The MC migration is the largest lift and must be isolated per `feedback_substrate_scope_restraint`.

* feat(memory-core): countMessages primitive + concept provenance docs (#10180)

Resolves #10180 — Mailbox polish on two adjacent surfaces.

**countMessages primitive (Problem 1 — retires the 100-cap proxy):**

`MailboxService.countMessages({box, status, fromIdentity?})` returns
`{count}` via direct SQL prepared statements joining `Edges` and `Nodes`,
patterned after `MemoryService.buildMailboxDelta` (#10178). Inbox path
uses the same 3-way UNION taxonomy (SENT_TO direct DM + DELIVERED_TO
per-recipient broadcast + SENT_TO AGENT:* legacy without DELIVERED_TO).
Outbox path counts SENT_BY edges from the caller. Permission-checked
via `CAN_READ_INBOX_OF` mirroring `listMessages`.

`getHealthcheckPreview` refactored to call `countMessages({status:
'unread'})` for `unreadCount` and `listMessages({limit: 3})` for the
preview surface, retiring the previous `listMessages({limit: 100})`
proxy pattern that silently under-reported any inbox with > 100 unread
messages.

**Concept provenance docs (Problem 2 — surfaces undocumented contract):**

- Write path: `MailboxService.addMessage` → `SemanticGraphExtractor
  .extractMessageConcepts` (fire-and-forget post-write)
- Node-side flag: `properties.auto_extracted: true` (set only on
  fresh-create, preserves curated node authority)
- Edge-weight convention: 0.8 auto vs 1.0 curated (20% rank delta
  calibrated to LLM precision gap)
- Read-time consumer pattern for DreamService / Librarian / future
  GraphRAG ranking and filtering

`SemanticGraphExtractor.extractMessageConcepts` JSDoc extended with
`@see` cross-references to the new ConceptOntology section + the caller

between code and substrate docs.

- 2026-05-17T09:49:48Z @neo-opus-ada cross-referenced by PR #11535
- 2026-05-17T19:05:15Z @neo-opus-ada cross-referenced by #10982
- 2026-05-17T19:42:51Z @tobiu referenced in commit `54c0cf1` - "feat(memory-core): archiveMessage + deleteMessage + retraction semantics (#10148) (#11535)

Resolves #10148

Adds two new MailboxService lifecycle primitives beyond markRead:
archiveMessage (recipient-side hide-from-default-view) and deleteMessage
(sender-side permanent retraction with thread-context preservation).

## What shipped

**MailboxService.archiveMessage({messageId}):**
- Recipient-only (mirrors markRead permission gate: SENT_TO match for
  direct DMs; per-recipient DELIVERED_TO match for broadcasts)
- Direct DM path: stamps `archivedAt` ISO timestamp on MESSAGE node
- Broadcast path: stamps `archivedAt` on per-recipient DELIVERED_TO edge
  (each recipient archives their own copy independently, mirroring the
  #11029 readAt convention)
- Reversible-by-design: re-list via `listMessages({includeArchived: true})`

**MailboxService.deleteMessage({messageId}):**
- Sender-only (SENT_BY match required)
- Permanently overwrites `subject` + `bodyText` with `'[retracted by sender]'`
  + sets `retracted: true` flag
- All edges (SENT_BY, SENT_TO, DELIVERED_TO, PART_OF_THREAD, IN_REPLY_TO)
  survive so thread-context remains coherent — receivers see the
  placeholder where the message used to be, not an unexplained hole
- Irreversible (no undo path; original content overwritten at write-time)

**listMessages refactor:**
- New `includeArchived: false` parameter (default excludes archived)
- New `archivedAt` field surfaced on summary when archived + included
- New `retracted: true` field on summary when retracted (subject already
  shows placeholder via write-time replacement)

**MCP tool surface:**
- New `archive_message` operation (POST `/mailbox/messages/{messageId}/archive`)
- New `delete_message` operation (POST `/mailbox/messages/{messageId}/delete`)
- `list_messages` operation gains `includeArchived` query parameter
- toolService.mjs dispatch + openapi.yaml schema updated in sync

## Test coverage (4 new tests)

- AC1+AC4: archiveMessage hides direct DM from default listMessages; includeArchived surfaces with archivedAt in summary
- AC1: archiveMessage rejects non-recipient (sender + third-party); recipient still can (sanity-check)
- AC2+AC3: deleteMessage sender-side retraction replaces subject+body with placeholder; thread edges preserved; receiver views placeholder + retracted flag via listMessages + getMessage
- AC2: deleteMessage rejects non-sender (recipient + third-party); sender still can (sanity-check)

Test results: 56/56 on MailboxService.spec.mjs (52 baseline + 4 new).

## Substrate-shift note

Original #10148 body cites `ai/mcp/server/memory-core/` as the implementation
target. The service moved to `ai/services/memory-core/MailboxService.mjs` via
PR #11224 (memory-core flat SDK migration). Implementation here uses the
current path. The MCP tool dispatch + openapi.yaml in `ai/mcp/server/memory-core/`
ARE in the original cited location (unchanged by the migration).

## Out of Scope (per ticket)

- `purgeMessage` (hard-delete) — deferred; thread-context-rot is worse than
  visible placeholders per Avoided Traps
- Time-limited retraction window — retractions are permanent decisions
